query:
SELECT
                q.ord AS "ord!",
                i.id,
                i.name
            FROM UNNEST($1::vector[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS q(vec, ord)
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT id, name, clip_embedding <=> q.vec AS dist
                FROM images
                ORDER BY dist
                LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
            ) AS i
            ORDER BY q.ord, i.dist;
